role: Independent Cyrillic type and editorial reviewer
independence: No previous/current reviewer reports read before this report. Font/source unmodified.

tests.description: Russian pangram, representative sentence, UI labels, editorial numerals/punctuation at wght 100/400/900; sizes and matched opsz 9,12,14,16,20,32,64.
ДЛлдбвжкяЁй, нпилшщц, ЗЭзэ at 90 px, wght 100/400/900, opsz 9 and 128.
Russian paragraph at wght400, matched opsz and size 14/16/18 px, line-height1.5.

ui.reason: Regular at14–20 px is readable with visible Cyrillic distinctions and diacritics. Do not interpret this as approval for weight100 at9–14 px or weight900 at9 px; these extremes compromise clarity.

headings.reason: At32–64 px all tested weights show coherent, recognizable Russian shapes. 90 px optical endpoint specimens show no obvious broken joins, collisions, or anomalous Cyrillic skeleton.

body.reason: Weight400 paragraphs at14–18 px have legible forms, balanced running texture, and adequate word separation in the tested grayscale renderer.

sustained_reading.reason: A short static paragraph cannot establish fatigue, reading speed, or comprehension over extended use; no reader study or long-session evaluation was conducted.

findings.condition: Weight100 at9–14 px; black-on-white grayscale raster.
findings.evidence: proof-100.png lower three size groups show very pale stems and weak diacritics compared with regular.
findings.recommendation: Keep 100 for larger display text; use regular weight for small UI and body. No font-outline correction is warranted from this condition alone.
findings.acceptance_test: At intended UI size/rendering platform, verify normal-weight labels and diacritics at100% scale; do not require thin display weight to meet body-text goals.

findings.evidence: proof-900.png bottom groups show small counters and dense rhythm, especially в/б/я and multi-stem letters. Larger groups retain recognition.
findings.recommendation: Reserve extreme black for short emphasis/headings. Validate small bold UI at its actual size before selecting900.
findings.acceptance_test: Review target labels containing въ/бв/я/ж/шщ in the target native renderer at minimum intended size and reject any unreadable label.

findings.condition: All tested weights; characteristic ДЛлд and жкя.
findings.evidence: characteristics.png shows flat-top Д/Л/л/д with a curved left entry; ж/к use direct diagonal joins. Ё dots and й breve are separate and recognizable at display sizes.
findings.recommendation: Retain these coherent sans-serif constructions unless the design brief explicitly requires different Cyrillic forms. Their geometry is not itself a linguistic or type-quality defect.
findings.acceptance_test: Continue using the characteristic-string proof after revisions; require recognizable distinctions and consistent construction, not a prescribed triangular form.

limitations: FreeType grayscale rasterization and HarfBuzz shaping only; no CoreText, DirectWrite, browser, print, dark-mode, or high-DPI validation.
No claim of native-speaker panel review; this is an independent visual/editorial audit.
189 cmap entries and axes verified; complete Cyrillic language coverage, combining-mark behavior, all weight intermediates and kerning pairs were outside this bounded review.
No genuine outline-shape defect was established in the tested Cyrillic forms. Short specimen passing does not imply every string or platform passes.
